text:
marta: Brainstorm: run a cross-channel microexperiment tied to the quickstart flow. Idea = split-test 3 activation tactics for new signups who hit the API but don't save anything: (A) 150 free tokens, (B) templated starter pack + 50 tokens, (C) product walkthrough + 50 tokens. Goal = increase saved_prompt within 72h.

leo: Nice. Which users qualify? I'd target those with >=1 generation call in first 24h but zero saves after 24h. Exclude orgs on enterprise plans and recent promo recipients.

kevin: Quick power calc: baseline saved_prompt rate = 8%. To detect +3pp with 80% power, need ~10k users total. We can run for 3 weeks or narrow audience to early-week cohorts to hit numbers faster.

tara: Channels: in-console modal, email, and optional Slack Workspace DM (if workspace integrated). We should test single-touch vs multi-touch combos.

marta: We'll own the copy. Propose CTA variants: "Save this prompt & get more tokens" vs "Try the starter pack". Keep copy short.

leo: On the backend side, reuse /exp/grant. Add fields: channel, arm. Example payload: 
```
POST /exp/grant
{ user_id: "U321", exp_id: "exp-2026-05-quickstart-split", arm: "templates+50", channel: "in-console" }
```
Make idempotent.

kevin: Analytics: primary = saved_prompt within 72h. Secondary: gen_calls_post_grant, sessions/day, retention 7d. Tag events with `exp_id` and `arm`. I'll add an experiment dashboard with lift and cost-per-lift.

tara: For the modal, microcopy options: 1) "Get started fast  Try our starter templates + 50 tokens" 2) "150 free tokens to explore the API" 3) "Follow a 60s walkthrough + rewards". Will mock today. :art:

marta: Marketing comms: short email + in-console + feature badge. Email subject A/B: "Your quickstart tokens are waiting" vs "3 starter templates to try now". We'll include `utm_campaign=quickstart-split-2026`.

growth-bot: Experiment created: id=exp-2026-05-quickstart-split, start=1774030000, end=1774230000, arms=3, channels=in-console,email,workspace-dm. Logged to #growth-experiments.

kevin: Lead routing rule: if user saves a prompt and calls >20 gens in 72h, mark as hot and post to Sales with `source=quickstart-split`. Else go to nurture after 7 days. Include `recent_usage` metrics in payload.

leo: Edge cases: users with multiple accounts, SSO-only orgs, or those who've previously redeemed credits. Exclude by flags: `promo_recent`, `sso_enforced`, `already_saved`.

marta: We'll include a short microsurvey on the post-save confirmation: "What did you build?" choices: support-bot, content-gen, search. Use that to tag leads.

kevin: Cost guardrail: set `daily_experiment_spend_cap` = $500. If exceeded, pause and notify #marketing. Also cap per-org auto-grant = 500 tokens.

tara: For Slack DM channel, ensure workspace admin consent and a rate limit. If DM fails, fallback to email with promo code.

marta: Timeline: draft copy today, assets by Thu, backend + analytics by Fri, soft-launch next Tues. Can eng QA the grant flow by Monday?

leo: Yep. I'll slot an hour for QA and verify event wiring.

support: Note: add support playbook for users who ask "how do I apply these tokens?" Include quick troubleshooting and promo code flow. I'll draft the doc.

kevin: Measurement plan: run intermediate checks daily for redemption rate and early lift. Full analysis after 3 weeks, include subgroup analysis by region and use-case.

marta: Great. I'll post the three email bodies + modal mocks in #marketing-drafts. Tagging @leo @kevin @tara. :rocket:
